name: Efalizumab-driven CD11a turnover
description: Concentration-driven CD11a target-turnover module using Chetty Table 1 and the stated quasi-steady-state binding approximation. Free, bound and total target are distinct outputs. External constant effect-site concentration is an exploratory input; original Simcyp PK and PASI coupling are unresolved.

target_baseline.name: Drug-free target baseline
target_baseline.description: Table 1 Rmax, estimated by source authors.

complex_internalization.name: Complex internalization
complex_internalization.description: Table 1 Kint; interpreted first-order rate, printed unit conflict retained.

binding_half_concentration.name: QSS binding constant
binding_half_concentration.description: Table 1 Km=(koff+kint)/kon, not the FcRn KD.

driver_ug_ml.name: Free efalizumab effect-site concentration
driver_ug_ml.description: Exploratory external input; no PK prediction or dose conversion is implied.

eta_target_degradation.name: Individual log-degradation effect
eta_target_degradation.description: Deterministic log-multiplier, not a recovered source random-effects distribution.
